chunks: O Joseph, O the truthful, tell us the interpretation of seven fat cows being devoured by seven lean ones, and seven green ears of corn and seven dry ones, so that I may return to the people so they may know.

key_terms.الصِّدِّيقُ: The Truthful / The One who confirms truth

ai.seo_question: What did Joseph interpret the dream of the seven fat and seven lean cows to mean?
ai.summary: In this verse, the courtiers or Pharaoh address Yusuf (AS) as 'Al-Siddiq' (the Truthful/Veracious), a title of high honor in Shia tradition that underscores his integrity and divine insight. The dream of seven fat and lean cows alongside green and dry grain symbolizes seven years of agricultural abundance followed by seven years of severe famine, a prediction Yusuf accurately delivers to ensure Egypt's survival. This interpretation not only establishes his administrative authority but also serves as a practical model for economic planning and resource management in Islamic governance.
